controls.title: Driver Torque Override Threshold
controls.desc: Steering torque (Nm) required to consider the driver overriding lateral control. Higher values require stronger driver input before Flow Pilot disengages steering.

controls.title: Ford Lateral Precision Mode
controls.desc: Choose the lateral control precision. Comfortable reduces steering jerk; Precise is more direct.

controls.title: BluePilot Lane Positioning Pipeline
controls.desc: Enable the BluePilot lane positioning pipeline. Use the Steering panel Lane Positioning controls to tune.

controls.title: Bluepilot HUD Enhancements
controls.desc: Enable Bluepilot-style HUD messaging for hands-on alerts and lane centering status.

controls.title: Lane Centering Button Events
controls.desc: Send lane-centering button events for MADS toggling. Disable to ignore the steering wheel LC button.

controls.title: Inhibiting Events Heartbeat
controls.desc: Append inhibiting events to the Ford controller heartbeat log line.

controls.title: Steering Indicator in Heartbeat
controls.desc: Show steering direction/effort next to the Ford controller heartbeat.

controls.title: Steering Indicator Source
controls.desc: Choose the indicator source for the heartbeat display.

controls.title: Steering Rate Profile
controls.desc: Curvature rate limits that control steering response. Bluepilot is more responsive; Legacy is smoother but slower.

controls.title: CAN-FD Lateral Accel Cap
controls.desc: Max lateral acceleration cap for CAN-FD platforms. CAN-FD steering can apply more torque and safety limits don't account for road roll, so this reduces aggressive curvature on banked roads. Off disables the extra cap.

controls.title: No-Lane-Line Bias
controls.desc: Bias when lane lines are not trusted. Units are 1e-4 curvature per step. Positive values bias right; negative bias left. 0 disables the bias.

controls.title: Center Crosshair Overlay
controls.desc: Show a center crosshair on the on-road camera view for mounting alignment.

controls.title: Reset Extrinsic Calibration
controls.desc: Clear the camera extrinsic calibration so it can be recalibrated.

controls.title: Use Bluepilot Ford Stack
controls.desc: Switch Ford control logic between the legacy Flow Pilot stack and the Bluepilot stack. Changing this requires a restart.

controls.title: Fetch Updates
controls.desc: Refresh branch and commit lists from remotes.

controls.title: Target Branch
controls.desc: Pick a branch (sorted by most recent commit).

controls.title: Target Commit
controls.desc: Select from the last 20 commits in the selected branch (newest first).

controls.title: Restart Flow Pilot Back-End
controls.desc: Checkout the selected ref and restart Flow Pilot services.
controls.confirm_text: This will checkout the selected ref and restart Flow Pilot. Continue?

controls.title: Stash & Restart Flow Pilot
controls.desc: Stash local changes, checkout the selected ref, and restart Flow Pilot services.
controls.confirm_text: This will stash local changes, checkout the selected ref, and restart Flow Pilot. Continue?
